name: DynamoDbDelete
label: Delete AWS DynamoDB Item
description: Deletes an item from AWS DynamoDB using the DeleteItem API.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: The name of the DynamoDB table to delete an item from.

fields.name: Return
fields.label: Return
fields.description: Specifies whether to return attribute values of the deleted item.

fields.name: Keys
fields.label: Keys
fields.description: The primary key(s) of the item to delete.

fields.name: Simplify
fields.label: Simplify
fields.description: If enabled, returns only the key values of the deleted item.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields to include in the request.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the DynamoDB table is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS DynamoDB.

fields.name: DeletedItem
fields.label: Deleted Item
fields.description: The deleted item's attribute values (if Return = Attribute Values).

fields.name: KeyValues
fields.label: Key Values
fields.description: The key values of the deleted item (if Simplify is enabled).
